errors.says: Over F_2 every nonzero edge residual contains a vector of norm one, so it is nondegenerate and nonalternating and therefore has an orthonormal basis.
errors.paper: A norm-one vector only makes a residual nonalternating. Nondegeneracy comes separately from the orthogonal decompositions ('Each residual is nondegenerate by the decompositions above'), and both are needed for the orthonormal basis.

errors.says: Since Phi_{M'}Phi_M=Phi_{M'+M} commutes with pointwise XOR gates, the frame identity ... give Phi_{I_m} on every original row.
errors.paper: Two separate facts are needed. Phi_{M'}Phi_M=Phi_{M'+M} is the composition law (1508). The frame identity applies because a common address permutation commutes with every pointwise bit gate (1517-1519). The composition identity itself does not 'commute with gates'.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route end to end. S1 builds the two fast tape procedures from the bank-exchange networks, frames, labels and rank counts, giving s<Wm, tau=1-2^{-50}, the interchange and layer recurrences. S2 builds synthetic-transform convolution, S3 does the CRT/resampling/chirp/twist reduction and exact recovery, and S4 sums normalized costs to O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}), with S5 drawing the conclusion. The thinnest parts are the label construction (the stage transitions and gate-label table behind the central loss of h are only quoted), the complex-network endpoint identity C^{⊗m} (stated, not derived), and the chirp identity (only quoted). None of these breaks the chain.

steps.note: The plan gives the fixed eight-row network on triples of [100] with intersection rules, the exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a), and the restoration of every auxiliary wire. N=binom(100,3)^3 and m=h^3 are not written out, but m follows from F=Q^100 and F^{⊗3} of dimension m, and N counts the X_a.
A common frame per gate commutes with the pointwise gate, the network implements D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and the intermediate frames are free so each edge costs only a change of frame.
Nondegenerate labels in F^{⊗3} of dimension m, comparable labels on every edge, and only the central edges from time 3 to 4 decrease, each losing h=100. All are stated in the role they play.
rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U for nested nondegenerate labels, and the N source edges 2P_{U_a} are rank-one exceptions where the dimension change is zero.
The sum of |Delta dim| is Wm-2N+2L, with L = 100 x (number of central wires) = Ich, and s_b=(W_b m-2N+2L_b)+N=W_b m-N+2L_b.
L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, both below 1/2, give the deficits N-2L_b>0 and 2N-2L_c>0, hence s<Wm.
M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m on every role via P_{U_a^⊥}+P_{U_a}=I_m. With frames Phi_M the bit network applies H<-H+D on every row, scratch rows included.
A=E_1 Pi E_2 with a ones in Pi, giving exactly a interchanges plus O(V) per edge shear. The node therefore makes exactly s recursive calls.
Children have volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), and s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50} from deficits >20·2^{-50} and log m<20, so F_k=O(e^tau).

central.summary: All nine steps of the central saving are reconstructed with their defining content and in their chain roles: network, frames, labels, rank = dimension change with N exceptional source edges, budget Wm-2N+2L, the strict deficit from L/N<1/2, the endpoint shear identity, rank-many recursive interchanges, and the recurrence giving O(e^tau). The only thinness is in C1, where N and m are implicit rather than written as binom(100,3)^3 and 100^3.
